Cloud version usage notes (bottom of the page, small gray text)

Source: R/cloud.R
kit_cloud_footer.Rd

A title, a few sections (bold section title followed by a period, then the body), and a final line of reference links (opening in new tabs). Section titles run into the body and body pieces are joined into one paragraph, with no spaces inserted by HTML. The header banner can link here with <a href="#kit-cloud-terms">.

Usage

kit_cloud_footer(
  sections,
  links = NULL,
  title = "雲端版使用須知",
  id = "kit-cloud-terms"
)

Arguments

sections

The sections: a named list or character vector; names are section titles ("一、資料傳輸與儲存", "1. Data transfer and storage"), values are the body text (a character vector, joined directly).

links

Reference links: a named character vector, names are the link text and values are URLs; NULL omits this line.

title

The title at the top.

id

The footer's id (used by the banner's link).

Value

<footer id="kit-cloud-terms" class="kit-cloud-footer">.

See also

kit_cloud_banner(), kit_is_cloud()

Examples

# Sections: "1. Data transfer and storage", "2. Disclaimer"
kit_cloud_footer(
  sections = list(
    "一、資料傳輸與儲存" = c("本雲端版部署於 Posit Connect Cloud。",
                             "本工具不另行保存您的資料。"),
    "二、免責聲明" = "本工具以現況提供。"
  ),
  links = c("Posit Trust Center" = "https://trust.posit.co")
)
#> <footer id="kit-cloud-terms" class="kit-cloud-footer">
#>   <div class="kit-cloud-footer-title">雲端版使用須知</div>
#>   <p>
#>     <strong>一、資料傳輸與儲存。</strong>本雲端版部署於 Posit Connect Cloud。本工具不另行保存您的資料。
#>   </p>
#>   <p>
#>     <strong>二、免責聲明。</strong>本工具以現況提供。
#>   </p>
#>   <p>
#>     參考連結：
#>     <a href="https://trust.posit.co" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Posit Trust Center</a>
#>   </p>
#> </footer>
